summary_md: **peppa ([@peppashen](https://x.com/peppashen/status/2115386822935425151))** (in Chinese) highlights **HarnessMM**, which caches a harness's past decisions as a reusable "decision graph"; per the post, tokens per task fall from 96k to 12k while success rises from 71% to 86%.

referenced_urls.title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency

relevance: Cost reduction by reusing harness decisions rather than switching to smaller models.
